extracted.intended_audience: stand-up comedians and entertainment/production professionals (Comedy Central contestants, show producers, and creative agencies)
extracted.subtask_description: Rules and production brief for Comedy Central's Jeff Ross' Roast Battle: performer requirements (what is allowed onstage) and the show's creative packaging deliverables and inspiration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Original material only
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explicit rule for Roast Battle performers: jokes/insults must be original (prevents recycled material/quoting others). No additional examples or scoring notes provided on the page.

rubrics_metrics.name: No physical contact
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Performers must not engage in physical contact during battles. Page gives no further exception details or enforcement mechanism.

rubrics_metrics.name: Every battle ends with a hug
rubrics_metrics.description: every battle ends with a hug
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Social/ritual requirement: despite the insult format, battles conclude with a hug between competitors. No further guidance given.

rubrics_metrics.name: Judging by a panel of celebrity comedians
rubrics_metrics.description: Jeff Ross’ Roast Battle is a stand-up insult war judged by a panel of celebrity comedians.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluation is performed by celebrity-comedian judges (subjective comedic judgment); the page does not list explicit scoring criteria used by the panel.

rubrics_metrics.name: Competition format — single champion from 16 contestants
rubrics_metrics.description: 16 comedians enter the ring, but only one will emerge as the year's Roast Battle Champion.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Implies an elimination/tournament format culminating in one champion; no bracket mechanics or scoring details provided.

rubrics_metrics.name: Design brief — show packaging objective
rubrics_metrics.description: Comedy Central needed show packaging to bring this war of words to life.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: High-level production objective: create visual/branding treatment that reflects the show's tone. Page describes the creative aim but does not give explicit production specifications beyond inspiration and deliverables.

rubrics_metrics.name: Design inspiration — basements and back alleys of comedy nightlife
rubrics_metrics.description: marketing materials inspired by the basements and back alleys of comedy nightlife.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Visual/atmospheric direction for the design system and animation: evoke underground comedy venues. No color palettes, typography, or technical specs given on the page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Deliverables / project types
rubrics_metrics.description: Project Type: Brand Identity, Animation + Film, Illustration; created an intro animation sequence, design system, and marketing materials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies the types of creative work produced for the show—useful as a checklist of required outputs for similar projects. No timing, duration, or technical delivery requirements listed.
